intents.name: Battery and Power Issues
intents.definition: Reports of rapid battery drain, unexpected shutdowns, failure to charge, or overheating.

intents.name: OS Performance and Stability
intents.definition: General lag, freezing, unexpected reboots, app crashes, or input/keyboard glitches, typically following a software update.

intents.name: Connectivity and Call Failures
intents.definition: Wi-Fi dropping, Bluetooth pairing failures, cellular issues, or problems making/receiving calls.

intents.name: Data Recovery and Syncing
intents.definition: Lost files, deleted photos/contacts, missing backups, or iCloud sync problems.

intents.name: Billing and Subscriptions
intents.definition: Unauthorized charges, subscription cancellations, gift card usage, or App Store/Apple Music billing disputes.

intents.name: Hardware Damage and Physical Repair
intents.definition: Physically damaged devices, liquid spills, component defects, or AppleCare/repair coverage questions.

intents.name: Security and Fraud Reporting
intents.definition: Suspicious phishing emails, scam messages, or account security/verification concerns.

intents.name: Product Specs and How-To
intents.definition: General usage questions, feature capability questions, compatibility questions, or policy questions (e.g. recycling).

intents.name: Store and Support Experience
intents.definition: Feedback or complaints about Genius Bar appointments, Apple Store visits, or phone support quality.

intents.name: Other
intents.definition: Non-English messages, non-actionable venting/jokes, or messages that don't clearly fit any category above.
